response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS r, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.r) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.r - a.m) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE a.m IS NOT NULL AND s.r > a.m
